changes_vs_current: Sources rank brands, not flavors, so the top 11 are brand-level: Doritos Nacho Cheese #1, Lay's #2, Pringles #3, Cheetos #4 (Flamin' Hot Cheetos as a flavor line and Cool Ranch have no flavor-level data, so they are carried at 12-13 although they likely belong higher), Ruffles up, Goldfish/Cheez-It/Takis/Fritos/Popcorn/Tostitos all mid. Positions 12-24 are no-data carryovers in current order (avg 12.0 = 'no data' value). Circana 2025 potato chip sales (Frito-Lay $6.5B, Kellanov $1.5B, Cape Cod $460M, Utz $441M, Kettle $337M; https://www.snackandbakery.com/articles/114108-state-of-the-industry-2025-chips-are-down-and-up) read but company-level, not used in the math.
confidence: low - only 3 sources, one editorial and one with only 4 relevant chip brands; no flavor-level poll or sales list found (Ranker's 100 Best Chips page blocked, HTTP 401; Statista brand purchase survey n=439 paywalled; Circana brand-level data not public). Brand order Doritos/Lay's/Pringles/Cheetos is solid across all three; everything below ~#11 is unverified.
